entries.title: Psalms 127:1
segments: In all our undertakings it is our duty to use with diligence and prudence the means of success; but unless God add his blessing, our labor will be in vain.

entries.title: Psalms 127:2
segments: The bread of sorrows; bread earned by hard and painful toil.

So; by aiding in building the house and keeping the city. 
 
  His beloved; the man whom he loves and takes under his protection. The meaning is, that they whom God loves and helps, accomplish easily and successfully the business of the day, and enjoy quiet sleep after it. 
 
Unbelief and practical atheism, by filling the mind in God has a tranquillizing influence, which is equally conducive to comfort and success.

entries.title: Psalms 127:3
segments: A heritage of the Lord; an inheritance given by the Lord.

entries.title: Psalms 127:4
segments: Children of the youth; born in the youth of the parents, and consequently of sufficient maturity and vigor to defend them in their old age.

entries.title: Psalms 127:5
segments:
They shall not be ashamed; the children, when they defend their parents; for they shall be successful. 
 
  In the gate; where causes were heard and decided by the judges. 
 
Well-trained and virtuous children are the best earthly defence and comfort of old age.
